interpretation_limits: A single selected final cannot estimate a causal tactical-matchup advantage.
Pre-final form is descriptive, unadjusted for opponent difficulty and extra time; it is not a calibrated paper-strength rating.
Separate coaching plan, player execution/finishing, score state, temperature, substitutions and opponent absences.
Do not turn whole-match pressure counts into intensity without possession exposure and time windows.
Phase shares retain FIFA definitions and are not renormalized to sum to100.
Game ratings may only serve as dated pre-match priors after verified identity joins; future updates/outcome fields must be excluded.

match.data_grain: whole-match tracking-derived aggregates, not raw event/trajectory coordinates
match.source_url: https://www.fifatrainingcentre.com/media/native/tournaments/fcwc/2025/M63 CHE V PSG POST MATCH REPORT.pdf

score_state_context.note: Club report describes a deeper second-half defence. The late PSG red card cannot explain the earlier 3-0 lead.

pre_final_form.definition: reported match scores; includes extra time where played, not per90 or opponent-adjusted paper strength
